notes.title: Server Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/5bfc20d9bde78808548baae34008bb78736d0a58.png


If you encounter any issues with Worms Rumble, please post a thread in our Report A Problem forum or contact our support team via the Team17 website

notes.title: Worms Rumble Patch - Bug fixes, achievement fixes and more...
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Let's kick off the week with a patch for Worms Rumble...

We've been working hard on fixes for issues reported by our players, including problems with movement and that pesky Hammerhead audio bug!

It also includes a fix for the last two trophies that players were having problems unlocking.

We've also added a DLC tab into the main menu of the game to make it easier to find the extra (paid) content that is available for Worms Rumble.

Check out the full patch notes below!

PATCH NOTES:

 Fixes for unlocking the Geared Up and Tooled Up achievements if criteria had already been met before previous patch 
 Fixed an issue which prevented the held button commands to work on elevators, crates and weapons 
 Fixed an additional issue where the player was unable to move when the game starts. 
 Fixed an issue where the pre-game scoreboard cursor was not dismissed when the game starts. 
 Fixed an issue where the Hammerhead firing audio was played repeatedly. 
 Fixed an issue where the moving platforms in Deadly Dockyards could become desynced after the level event. 
 Fixed an issue where the controller disconnection was not displayed in game if the controller was disconnected in the main menus. 
 Fixed an issue where fake projectiles could be seen but would deal no damage. 
 Fixed an issue where players stuttered during spectate mode
 Added a DLC tab into the main menu

notes.title: New Map Update - Deadly Docks Next Week + The Lab 'Pistols At Dawn' Live Today!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to announce Deadly Docks our new map is coming to Worms Rumble next Thursday, December 17th! Also that The Lab opens at 3PM GMT today with the first gameplay experiment, 'Pistols at Dawn, where you can earn an exclusive gold skin for the event, but hurry, it closes in 48 hours!

Watch the new trailer set sail now:

[previewyoutube=PW10FWXKAFk;full][/previewyoutube]

Deadly Docks

We're shipping the new map, Deadly Docks next Thursday! Did anyone here guess this was the map from our teasers earlier in the week? Let us know in the comments below! 

We invite you to engage in total seaside warfare in this new map! As a working dock it's a busy place with moving platforms and even a ship that can cast-off during the match... bon voyage!

Take a bite out of these new purchasable premium outfits with a choice between a shark or captain outfit, both have 3 color variants included! Let us know which side you'll take!

notes.title: Worms Rumble Update - Main Crash Fix, New Content Tease and More!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/ea50bc2f6988d6c23c08eaae4318f81732a3f035.jpg

Hey everyone!

We continue to be over the moon with the reception to Worms Rumble! Thanks to everyone who has picked it up so far and we hope you are having a blast! Here's another bunch of fixes based on some of the most reported and requested changes for the community. You can also see the patch from a couple of days ago which rebalanced weapons and reduced the load wait time here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1186040/eventcomments/2974028351324673693/

Fixes

Main Crash Fix

We have had heaps of reports from players who selected 'close and submit' when they crashed, and from these we have a fix for the issue that was effecting the vast majority of players at the start of matches. Thanks again for all of your reports and we hope all of the people effected will have an even better time in Worms Rumble!

 Firing Backwards Fix 

We also have a fix for Worm aim direction desync which had caused players to fire backwards. Sorry for this quirk and hopefully all of your shots will now go where you're aiming!

Achievement Fixes


 Fix for Win Last Worm Standing trophy not being unlocked
 Fix for Win Deathmatch trophy not being unlocked
 Fix for Top 50 and Complete a match trophies not being unlocked correctly in Last Worm Standing and Last Squad standing gamemodes.


Other fixes

Fix a few rewards not unlocking properly:

 Black & Gold crown is now correctly a reward instead of a level 48 unlock
 Nuclear hoodie is now correctly a reward instead of a level 48 unlock
 Ananas lids 10 gallon hat is now correctly a reward instead of a level 48 unlock
 Galvanized Steel Worm skin is now correctly unlocked at level 50


We're still looking into a few of the other highly reported issues and requests and there will be more frequent patches... on top of that we have some new content coming soon. Can you guess what it is?

https://media.giphy.com/media/IQ41B4WfDJeMaH3dci/giphy.gif

That's it...for now

We'll be sure to tease the content update coming next week more very soon so keep a wormy eye out! 

See you all in the next patch, for now it's time to rumble!

Keep up to date with everything Worms Rumble in our socials:

Discord
Twitter

notes.title: Worms Rumble Update - Loading Wait Time Reduced and Weapon Buffs!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Worms Rumble landed on Steam yesterday and we were thrilled to see so many playing the game! We've had some amazing feedback so far, and have a patch based on your suggestions alongside our observations so far. This update does not require an update and should automatically update whilst you are in-game.

Weapon Buffs:
Revolver time between shots decreased from 0.25 to 0.2
Assault Rifle repeat fire time reduced from 0.2 to 0.15
Shotgun time between shots decreased from 0.75 to 0.65


Sheep Launcher reload time reduced from 1.0 to 0.8


Rocket Shield reload time reduced from 1.5 to 1.2
Rocket Shield fly time increased from 0.75 to 1.0

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38203235/84e9596ab9d5ee4a8ebc37b0da6e0a48969e7a50.png

These changes follow nerfs made after beta feedback and have now been buffed slightly based on everyone's thoughts so far. Please let us know your thoughts on these weapons now, if they are too strong, too weak still or just right!


Quality of Life:

Match load time reduction

We have significantly reduced the wait times into a match, before even if everyone had connected it would wait 60 seconds total, this is now 20 seconds a third of the time spent in the loading screen as people get into the match. We hope this will make getting into new matches much snappier! 

Next:

We continue to work on fixes for other issues reported by the community, please if you come across a crash use the 'submit and close' button to report them directly to us and also you can report any other issues to our support team in the report a problem section of our Steam forums.

See you all in the next patch, for now it's time to rumble!

Keep up to date with everything Worms Rumble in our socials:

notes.title: Closed Beta Patch #3 - Bug Fixes & More Shotgun Tweaks!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've just deployed another patch as we head into the weekend!

Following your feedback we've done some further adjustments to the Shotgun and fixes a few more bugs. 

Full details below:


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where remote players wouldn't face the correct direction when wall hanging.
Fixed an issue where projectiles could sometimes visually slowdown.
Fixed an issue where weapons wouldn't shoot after interrupting a reload.

Shotgun Balancing
Reduced pellets to 7
Slight increase in pellet spread
Slight reduction in range
Reduced knockback per pellet


That wraps up today's patch!

Good luck in the Missile Mall, watch out for those Holy Hand Grenades over the weekend!

notes.title: Closed Beta Patch #2 - Weapon Balancing!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We hope you're enjoying day 2 of the Worms Rumble Beta!

The team have been watching and taking note of your feedback and have put it into action...

Bug Fixes

Fixed a crash on startup when a VR device was plugged in.
Fixed an issue where audio when leveling up from 9 to 10 could infinitely loop.
Fixed total death stat showing double the amount of actual deaths.
Fixed overall K/D stat using the incorrect death count.
Grenades can now be reflected using the Baseball Bat.
Fixed an issue where the Grenade fuse time was being reset when colliding with geometry multiple times.
Fixed an issue where Gameplay Settings would not always be applied properly.


Weapon Balance Tweaks

Baseball Bat - Damage reduced to 30
Shotgun - Pellets increased from 5 to 8, Spread increased, Damage per pellet reduced to 10, Pellet speed increased
Assault Rifle - Time between shots reduced
Bazooka - Reload time/time between shots increased
Grenades - Tweaked bounciness and friction, Holy Hand Grenade AoE increased


There you have it! 

Let us know what you think of these weapon changes and how they fare on in Missile Mall!

Bug Report Forum

notes.title: Worms Rumble: Closed Beta Patch #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We hope you are enjoying the Worms Rumble beta so far – keep those feedback threads and bug reports coming!

We’ve just released a patch to address the following issues:

Fixed Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Portuguese-Brazilian always showing in English.
Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Korean will now display the correct fonts.
Bazooka rockets should now always shoot at the correct speed.
Reflected projectiles from the Baseball bat should now visibly change direction.
Fixed an issue with duplicate projectiles being spawned.
Fixed an issue where the weapon state would desync with the server and you are left unable to reload/shoot your weapon.
When a player disconnects during loading, the game should now always proceed into game.
Fixed a rare server crash.
XP and Currency should no longer be awarded from self-kills.
Fixed an discrepancy in damage numbers across multiple UI screens.
Various customisation items have had their names fixed to reflect the material applied.
Fixed an issue where repeated audio can be heard when levelling up from rank 9 to 10.
Fixed an issue when re-rolling your daily challenge would show incorrect progress. 


We are looking to address the below remaining known issues during the beta too:

Post-game flow doesn’t progress automatically on the player XP breakdown if player rank is maxed out. ‘Advance’ button needs to be pressed by the player. This will only happen when the player ranks up from lvl 9 – 10. A fix will be out before players reach this
Desync might be seen while attempting to perform multiple consecutive wall jumps
Flickering effect is present across background textures. This isn’t occurring for all players, and only seems to be happening on medium quality settings
The top player listed on the player list appears twice during the pre-game flow. We’ve noticed other duplications of players on the list at times also
Player's camera perspective sometimes changes immediately after dying. This only happens the first time the player dies
Re-rolled daily challenges show existing progress, suggesting that progress is added whilst they're inactive
The worm can occasionally disappear from the Worm tab preview
The levelling up sound effect on the post-game flow continues to play on an account that has reached level 10


That wraps up our first Beta patch! 

We hope you're all having a great time, we're looking forward to going through your feedback. From bugs to your thoughts and suggestions on what you like AND would like to see in the game go let us know!

Feedback Forum
Bug Report Forum

HALLELUJAH!
